denominator.metric: findings demonstrable on a real surface

findings.assert: group by (service_tower,business_function) yields >=3 distinct supplier_name above threshold
findings.claim: Three suppliers deliver the same service tower to one business function
findings.requires: 3+ contracts sharing service_tower whose scoped_applications resolve to apps sharing business_function and application_subdomain; combined annualized_value_usd above p90

findings.claim: A contract auto-renews inside the window with no way to stop it
findings.requires: end_date within 90d of demo_as_of_date; notice_window_days >= days remaining; benchmarking_right=false; minimum_commitment_usd>0; auto_renew=true

findings.claim: A declared cohort of contracts protects the vendor, not the client
findings.requires: exactly 34 of 230 with benchmarking_right=false AND minimum_commitment_usd>0 AND notice_window_days>=90 AND termination_for_convenience=false

findings.assert: group exists and every member counts via application_v, not deployments
findings.claim: One function runs 5+ applications in the same subdomain from 3+ vendors
findings.requires: 5+ apps sharing (business_function,application_subdomain), 3+ distinct vendor_name, lifecycle_state=active, combined annual_cost_usd above threshold

findings.assert: distinct technology count >=4 and the ungoverned row is present
findings.claim: The same workload runs on four or more BI technologies, one ungoverned
findings.requires: one function spanning 4+ distinct technology_name at same workload_type; >=1 governance_state ungoverned; material workload_count and active_user_count

findings.assert: platform exists with all attributes and relationship traversal returns >=4 apps via FK endpoints
findings.claim: A clinical function depends on an appliance losing vendor support
findings.requires: platform_type=netezza_appliance, clinical business_function, dr_tier in (tier_3_backup_only,unknown), high utilization_percent, support_end_date within 18m; 4+ related applications

findings.assert: unattributed sum equals declared amount and renders as a named gap with a denominator, never 0
findings.claim: A declared share of GL actuals attributes to nothing
findings.requires: 12% of finance rows with allocation_basis='unknown' AND null application_or_platform_ref

findings.assert: headline count equals number of rows that each explain themselves
findings.claim: Material value is gated, and every gated claim says why
findings.requires: value claims whose evidence carries verification_state='unverified'; 3+ distinct gate reason codes; each row carries claim_gate_status, claim_gate_reason_code, claim_gate_reason_detail, evidence_needed_json, next_gate

findings.assert: grouping by resolved vendor yields a clear leader and every exception traces to an evidence row that exists
findings.claim: Open control exceptions cluster on one vendor's estate
findings.requires: 5+ grc rows whose object_ref resolves to apps sharing one vendor_name; open_exception_count>0; severity high; control_state failing; resolvable evidence_ref

findings.assert: admission_status='refused' with populated refusal_json; not an empty state, not a zero
findings.claim: End-to-end data flow for one domain is correctly refused
findings.requires: a domain where the topology fitness gate genuinely fails - planted by omission, not by a flag
